title: Figure 32: Object Sighting Evaluations for Twelve US Regional Areas, with Strategic Areas
description: Map of the United States divided into twelve regional areas (e.g., North Far West, Central West, North Midwest, Central East, South East, South Midwest), each with a pie chart of evaluation categories (Astro, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other, Unknown) and a regional total. Heavily outlined, blocky zones mark the strategic areas. An inset at lower right covers the area east of Maine. Caption: "FIGURE 32 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY EVALUATION FOR THE TWELVE REGIONAL AREAS OF THE UNITED STATES, WITH THE STRATEGIC AREAS LOCATED (STRATEGIC AREAS WERE DETERMINED ON THE BASIS OF CONCENTRATION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS)".
